thread:
lee_engdocs: FYI: merged model-catalog PR but spotted 2 issues — the model-card link on the public catalog 404s and the 'max_context' field shows 4096 but benchmark uses 8192. Can someone take a quick look?

maria_research: ah yeah saw that locally. The model we added is the 8k context variant but I accidentally copied the 4k field. Repro: open https://docs.redwoodinference.com/models/zephyr-aurora and scroll to 'limits'

ben_runtime: I'm on it. Quick Q — is the deployed model the quantized int4 variant? That affects latency numbers in the bench table.

maria_research: yes it's the int4-quantized-8k variant. Bench numbers in PR were for int8 prior to quantize, so they need updating. Also compatibility note about 'kv-cache warmup' is missing.

lee_engdocs: assigning to @ben_runtime for bench numbers + link fix. @sam_sdk can you update the SDK snippet? The current python sample uses `model="zephyr-aurora"` but we should show variant tag `zephyr-aurora@8k-q4` per new model naming.

sam_sdk: will do. Proposed Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(model="zephyr-aurora@8k-q4", input="Summarize...", max_tokens=200, context_window=8192)
print(resp.text)
```
need to confirm param name is context_window in latest SDK.

ben_runtime: benchmark run done — updated latency p50/p95 for q4: p50=42ms (was 65ms), p95=120ms (was 190ms) at bs=1, seq=1024 on A100-80G. I'll drop a small table in the PR. Also updated the catalog link target to /models/zephyr-aurora@8k-q4 to avoid 404.

lee_engdocs: thanks. Can you also add a short compatibility note: 'Quantized q4 variants are functionally equivalent for generation but do not support BF16 kernels; fall back to FP16 on some ops' — that addresses customer question in #support earlier.

ben_runtime: added that line and a short note about 'kv-cache cold start may add ~30ms for first token'.

maria_research: One more: the benchmarks used 1024 seq length but the model card 'benchmarks' table header didn't say that. Added '(seq=1024, bs=1)' to each row.

sam_sdk: PR ready with snippet + small wording change to 'model_name@variant' migration guide. Also added a migration note in docs: 'If you used model="zephyr-aurora" before, update to explicit variant tag to ensure matching context window and quantization.'

lee_engdocs: perfect. I'll do a quick pass and merge after CI. Leaving a TODO: ensure external reference link to quantization guide points to https://docs.redwoodinference.com/ops/quantization-guide — currently it was linking to an internal draft.

docbot: CI check — links ok except one broken internal draft link flagged in files: docs/models/zephyr-aurora.md line 78.

lee_engdocs: fixed that link. Merging now. Thanks all :tada:
